_about: Template for Set-OmissisPolicy.ps1 -Settings (run as administrator or SYSTEM). The settings written here are LOCKED for every user of the PC; keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Remove the lines you do not want to lock.
_console: Only if you run a central console: its https address and the enrolment key of this customer. Set console_names to false to leave computer and user names out of the summary. console_pin is only for a console on the local network that made its own certificate: its SHA-256 fingerprint, given by the console; delete the line for a console with a public name and a regular certificate.
